intro: A store manager resume that shows the store you ran, the team you built, and the sales, margin and shrink you improved.
tips: Give the store's size: revenue, staff, square footage.
Show sales growth, margin, shrink and staff turnover.
Mention people you developed into leaders.

basics.name: David Kowalski
basics.label: Store Manager
basics.summary: Store manager with ten years in grocery and home retail. I run profitable stores with low staff turnover, and I have promoted six people into management.

work.name: DomPlus
work.summary: Home and garden store, 45 staff, PLN 60m a year.
highlights: Grew sales 22% in three years, the fastest in the region of 18 stores.
Cut shrink from 2.1% to 1.2% of sales with better stock control and training.
Halved staff turnover by rebuilding rotas around people's lives.

work.name: FreshMarket
highlights: Ran fresh food departments and the night replenishment team.
Led the store through a full refit while staying open.
